subject.title: fix(agents): repair orphaned tool_use pairs on compaction prune path

question: Should compaction use the same aborted-turn drop policy as prompt-send repair, accepting that aborted assistant tool-call turns are omitted from compaction summaries?
rationale: The code path is narrow and well covered, but the drop-vs-synthesize choice changes session-state recovery semantics and repository policy treats fallback/session behavior as compatibility-sensitive.

options.title: Accept drop policy
options.body: Merge after exact-head refresh, using the existing prompt-send policy for compaction to prevent strict-provider rejection.

options.title: Request synthetic recovery
options.body: Ask the contributor to preserve aborted turns with an explicit synthetic or unknown-state representation and add matching proof.

options.title: Pause for broader design
options.body: Hold the PR until maintainers decide a unified transcript-recovery policy across compaction, replay, and persisted repair.

recommendation.title: Accept drop policy
recommendation.body: Merge after exact-head refresh, using the existing prompt-send policy for compaction to prevent strict-provider rejection.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is the strongest feature-history owner for the shared session transcript repair policy that this PR applies to compaction.
